items.title: Why HubSpot Stock Is In Focus As Founder Returns And New CFO Joins
items.summary: HubSpot announced a major leadership reshuffle, with co founder Brian Halligan returning as CEO and Adobe executive Karen Burgess set to replace retiring CFO Kate Bueker in February 2027, while Bueker stays on as an adviser through the end of 2027. The leadership reset comes shortly after HubSpot reported US$947.57 million in Q3 2026 revenue, positive net income for both the quarter and year to date, and active share repurchase programs that together highlight a business balancing...
